issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Developer.init(_:monthsOfSwiftExperience:): the problem statement and the template declare the initializer parameter monthsOfSwiftExperience as an optional Int (Int?). The template signature is init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). The solution implementation declares a non-optional parameter init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int). The solution's Client code calls Developer(name: "Your Name", monthsOfSwiftExperience: nil) which is only valid if the initializer accepts Int?. This mismatch will cause a compilation error and will confuse students about the intended initializer signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the initializer signatures. Preferred fix: change the solution's Developer initializer to accept an optional Int to match the problem and template: init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). Update the implementation to assign the optional directly (self.monthsOfSwiftExperience = monthsOfSwiftExperience) and keep Client calls that pass nil unchanged. Alternatively, if the intended design is to require a non-optional Int, update the problem statement, the template initializer signature, and all client/test code to pass non-nil Int values (e.g., replace nil with 0 or another default).
